mapper.select: SELECT id, tool_name, tool_description, input_schema, groovy_script, linked_request_keys, linked_data_source_ids, is_enabled AS enabled, publish_status FROM mcp_dynamic_tool WHERE tool_name = #{toolName} AND is_enabled = 1 AND publish_status != 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, tool_name, tool_description, input_schema, groovy_script, linked_request_keys, linked_data_source_ids, is_enabled AS enabled, publish_status FROM mcp_dynamic_tool WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tool_name, tool_description, input_schema, groovy_script, linked_request_keys, linked_data_source_ids, is_enabled AS enabled, publish_status FROM mcp_dynamic_tool WHERE tool_name = #{toolName} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, tool_name, tool_description, input_schema, groovy_script, linked_request_keys, linked_data_source_ids, is_enabled AS enabled, publish_status FROM mcp_dynamic_tool ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, tool_name, tool_description, input_schema, groovy_script, linked_request_keys, linked_data_source_ids, is_enabled AS enabled, publish_status FROM mcp_dynamic_tool WHERE is_enabled = 1 AND publish_status = 2 ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_dynamic_tool (tool_name, tool_description, input_schema, groovy_script, linked_request_keys, linked_data_source_ids, is_enabled, publish_status) VALUES (#{toolName}, #{toolDescription}, #{inputSchema}, #{groovyScript}, #{linkedRequestKeys}, #{linkedDataSourceIds}, #{enabled}, #{publishStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE mcp_dynamic_tool SET tool_name=#{toolName}, tool_description=#{toolDescription}, input_schema=#{inputSchema}, groovy_script=#{groovyScript}, linked_request_keys=#{linkedRequestKeys}, linked_data_source_ids=#{linkedDataSourceIds}, is_enabled=#{enabled}, publish_status=#{publishStatus} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE mcp_dynamic_tool SET is_enabled=#{enabled}, publish_status=CASE WHEN #{enabled}=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mcp_dynamic_tool WHERE is_enabled=1 AND publish_status != 0
